snapshot.capital_scaled: ₹2–10 crore for licences, a product team, compliance and customer acquisition
snapshot.margin_d2c: Fees, interest spread or subscriptions depending on the product
snapshot.margin_production: Partner banks and NBFCs take a share of revenue
snapshot.distribution_note: Trust and compliance are the barriers; partnerships open distribution

tailwinds: UPI has made digital payments universal in India.
Account Aggregator and credit data make lending decisions faster.
Small businesses and new earners are underserved by banks.
headwinds: RBI and SEBI rules are strict and change often.
Large players like PhonePe, Paytm and banks dominate payments.
angle_2026: RBI has tightened rules on digital lending, and payments are dominated by large players. In 2026, fintech startups that succeed partner with regulated banks or NBFCs, focus on one underserved group, and make compliance a strength.
cost_basis: Estimated for a small team building one financial product with a regulated partner, 2026 prices.

unit_economics.example: For a customer paying ₹100 a month:
rows: ₹40–60 a month once acquisition is paid back
unit_economics.note: Retention and default rates decide everything.

investor_probes: Which licences or partners do you need?
What is your default or fraud rate?
How long does a customer stay?
bootstrap_takeaway: Partner with a regulated bank or NBFC instead of seeking your own licence at first. Prove demand with a narrow group of customers.
licences: RBI licence or a regulated partner (bank or NBFC) depending on the product
Compliance with RBI digital lending guidelines
SEBI registration for investment advice or distribution

hard_truths.title: Regulation
hard_truths.text: Rules change often. Budget for legal advice.

hard_truths.title: Trust
hard_truths.text: People are cautious with money. Transparency is essential.

hard_truths.title: Defaults and fraud
hard_truths.text: Lending and payments attract fraud. Invest in risk systems.

hard_truths.title: Big competitors
hard_truths.text: Large players have huge user bases. Find a niche.

plan_goal: The aim is a regulated partner signed and 500 active customers.

plan.title: Validate
steps: Pick one customer group and problem.
